meta.name: prototype
meta.description: 快速原型工作流。跳过正常标准以快速验证游戏概念或机制。产出可丢弃的代码和结构化的原型报告。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速验证游戏概念或机制
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发早期快速试错并产出可丢弃的代码
copy.tagline_en: Quickly validate game concepts or mechanics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to rapidly experiment and produce throwaway code in early development

howto.what: 当您提供一个游戏概念或机制描述时，Claude会创建原型计划和隔离目录，编写可丢弃的代码，运行测试，并生成包含假设、结果、指标和建议的结构化原型报告。
howto.when: 当您主动调用此技能并描述一个需要快速验证的游戏概念或机制时触发。

say.text: 我想快速验证一个平台跳跃游戏的传送门机制，写一个原型。
帮我测试一个Roguelike地图生成的概念，只需要核心算法。
say.note: Claude会专注于最小可行原型。

howto.what_en: When given a game concept or mechanic description, Claude creates a prototype plan and isolated directory, writes disposable code, runs tests, and generates a structured report with hypotheses, results, metrics, and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you invoke the skill with a concept description for rapid validation of game ideas or mechanics.

say_en.text: I want to quickly prototype a teleport mechanic for a platformer.
say_en.note: Claude will build and test the prototype.

say_en.text: Test a Roguelike map generation concept, core algorithm only.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on minimal viable prototype.
